request.style: English, slow Delta blues, weathered deep male vocal, slide guitar, acoustic guitar, harmonica, upright bass, brushed drums, heavy and soulful, 66 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I had sons and I had daughters, I had cattle on the plain
I was known in all the East and my barns were full of grain
Then the messengers came running and they told me one by one
Fire and raiders and a great wind, and my children all were gone

[Chorus]
Naked I came from my mother's womb
And naked I will return
The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away
Blessed be the name of the LORD

[Verse]
Sores from my head down to my feet, I sat in ash and dust
My friends said I must have sinned, for God is always just
I cried into the silence and no answer came around
Oh, that my words were written down

[Bridge]
But I know that my Redeemer lives
And in the end he will stand upon the dust
Yet in my flesh I will see God
I myself will see him
My own eyes will behold him

[Verse]
Then the LORD answered Job out of the storm
Where were you when I laid the earth's foundation
I put my hand upon my mouth, I'd talked of things too high
I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear
But now my eye has seen you

[Chorus]
Naked I came from my mother's womb
And naked I will return
The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away
Blessed be the name of the LORD

[Outro]
I know that my Redeemer lives
Blessed be the name of the LORD
